senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.מִשְׁנָה , Mishnah, esp. (in Babli) collection of Mishnahs not embodied in the Mishnah of R. Judah, as Boraitha, Tosefta &c., contrad. to מַתְנִיתִין (abbr. מתני׳) our Mishnah, i.e. the Mishnah proper.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 26:9">Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 9</cite>.—

<cite ref="Taanit 21a:5">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>אי איכא שאיל לי במ׳ דר׳ … ממתניתין</he> (differ. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) if there be one that will ask me something from the Mishnah of R. Ḥiya or of R. Oshia which I cannot answer from our Mishnah.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:1:2">Y. M. Kat. II, beg. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מַתְנִיתָן צריכה לדר׳ חייא וכ׳</he> our Mishnah needs (for explanation) that of R. Ḥiya, and R. Ḥia’s needs ours.
Ib. מַתְנִיתֵיה דר׳ וכ׳ the collection of &c.; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. school, college.
<cite ref="Pesachim 101b:3">Pes. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳ דבי וכ׳</he> at the school of the house of Rab Hineḳ &c. (where Mishnah was taught).
<cite ref="Ketubot 104a:22">Keth. 104ᵃ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—[Y. Ned. IV, 38ᶜ bot. <he>מתניתין נסבין וכ׳</he>, read: <he>מַתְנְיָינִין</he>.]—Pl. <he>מַתְנְיָיתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25b:19">Ber. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ קשיין אהדרי</he> the two Boraithas quoted contradict each other!—
<cite ref="Niddah 33b:14">Nidd. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ותני מ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="M03094"><he>מתניתא</he></cite>) and he teaches Mishnahs.
